mapper.select:
SELECT m.MENU_ID as menuId, m.MENU_NM as menuNm, m.MENU_DC as menuDc, m.PARENT_MENU_ID as parentMenuId, m.MENU_ORDR as menuOrdr, m.MENU_URL as menuUrl, m.ICON_NM as iconNm, m.USE_AT as useAt, m.CRT_DT as frstRegistPnttm, m.CRT_ID as frstRegisterId, m.UPD_DT as lastUpdtPnttm, m.UPD_ID as lastUpdusrId, p.MENU_NM as parentMenuNm, CASE WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM tb_menu_info c WHERE c.PARENT_MENU_ID = m.MENU_ID) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END as hasChildren FROM tb_menu_info m LEFT JOIN tb_menu_info p ON m.PARENT_MENU_ID = p.MENU_ID WHERE 1=1
AND m.MENU_NM LIKE CONCAT('%', #{menuNm}, '%')
AND m.PARENT_MENU_ID = #{parentMenuId}
ORDER BY m.PARENT_MENU_ID, m.MENU_ORDR, m.MENU_ID

SELECT m.MENU_ID as menuId, m.MENU_NM as menuNm, m.MENU_DC as menuDc, m.PARENT_MENU_ID as parentMenuId, m.MENU_ORDR as menuOrdr, m.MENU_URL as menuUrl, m.ICON_NM as iconNm, m.USE_AT as useAt, m.CRT_DT as frstRegistPnttm, m.CRT_ID as frstRegisterId, m.UPD_DT as lastUpdtPnttm, m.UPD_ID as lastUpdusrId, p.MENU_NM as parentMenuNm FROM tb_menu_info m LEFT JOIN tb_menu_info p ON m.PARENT_MENU_ID = p.MENU_ID WHERE m.MENU_ID = #{menuId} ORDER BY m.PARENT_MENU_ID, m.MENU_ORDR, m.MENU_ID
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO tb_menu_info ( MENU_ID, MENU_NM, MENU_DC, PARENT_MENU_ID, MENU_ORDR, MENU_URL, ICON_NM, USE_AT, CRT_DT, CRT_ID, UPD_DT, UPD_ID ) VALUES ( #{menuId}, #{menuNm}, #{menuDc}, #{parentMenuId} NULL, #{menuOrdr}, #{menuUrl}, #{iconNm}, #{useAt}, GETDATE(), #{frstRegisterId}, GETDATE(), #{lastUpdusrId} )
mapper.update: UPDATE tb_menu_info SET MENU_NM = #{menuNm}, MENU_DC = #{menuDc}, PARENT_MENU_ID = #{parentMenuId} NULL, MENU_ORDR = #{menuOrdr}, MENU_URL = #{menuUrl}, ICON_NM = #{iconNm}, USE_AT = #{useAt}, UPD_DT = GETDATE(), UPD_ID = #{lastUpdusrId} WHERE MENU_ID = #{menuId}
mapper.select:
SELECT PERMISSION_ID as permissionId, PERMISSION_NM as permissionNm, PERMISSION_DC as permissionDc, PERMISSION_LEVEL as permissionLevel, USE_AT as useAt, CRT_DT as frstRegistPnttm, CRT_ID as frstRegisterId, UPD_DT as lastUpdtPnttm, UPD_ID as lastUpdusrId FROM tb_permission_type WHERE USE_AT = 'Y'
AND PERMISSION_NM LIKE CONCAT('%', #{permissionNm}, '%')
AND PERMISSION_LEVEL = #{permissionLevel}
ORDER BY SORT_ORDR
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO tb_permission_type ( PERMISSION_ID, PERMISSION_NM, PERMISSION_DC, PERMISSION_LEVEL, USE_AT, CRT_DT, CRT_ID, UPD_DT, UPD_ID ) VALUES ( #{permissionId}, #{permissionNm}, #{permissionDc}, #{permissionLevel}, #{useAt}, GETDATE(), #{frstRegisterId}, GETDATE(), #{lastUpdusrId} )
mapper.select: SELECT AUTHORITY_CODE as authorityCode, AUTHORITY_NM as authorityNm, AUTHORITY_LEVEL as authorityLevel, TENANT_SCOPED as tenantScoped, USE_AT as useAt, CRT_DT as frstRegistPnttm, CRT_ID as frstRegisterId, UPD_DT as lastUpdtPnttm, UPD_ID as lastUpdusrId FROM tb_authorityinfo ORDER BY AUTHORITY_LEVEL, AUTHORITY_CODE
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO tb_authorityinfo ( AUTHORITY_CODE, AUTHORITY_NM, AUTHORITY_LEVEL, TENANT_SCOPED, USE_AT, CRT_DT, CRT_ID, UPD_DT, UPD_ID ) VALUES ( #{authorityCode}, #{authorityNm}, #{authorityLevel}, #{tenantScoped}, #{useAt}, GETDATE(), #{frstRegisterId}, GETDATE(), #{lastUpdusrId} )

INSERT INTO tb_role_menu_permission ( AUTHORITY_CODE, MENU_ID, PERMISSION_ID, USE_AT, CRT_DT, CRT_ID, UPD_DT, UPD_ID ) VALUES ( #{authorityCode}, #{menuId}, #{permissionId}, #{useAt}, GETDATE(), #{frstRegisterId}, GETDATE(), #{lastUpdusrId} )
mapper.select: SELECT DISTINCT m.MENU_ID as menuId, m.MENU_NM as menuNm, m.MENU_DC as menuDc, m.PARENT_MENU_ID as parentMenuId, m.MENU_ORDR as menuOrdr, m.MENU_URL as menuUrl, m.ICON_NM as iconNm, m.USE_AT as useAt, CASE WHEN MAX(p.PERMISSION_LEVEL) = 'write' THEN 'write' ELSE 'read' END as permissionLevel, 1 as accessible FROM tb_menu_info m INNER JOIN tb_role_menu_permission rmp ON m.MENU_ID = rmp.MENU_ID INNER JOIN tb_permission_type p ON rmp.PERMISSION_ID = p.PERMISSION_ID WHERE m.USE_AT = 'Y' AND rmp.USE_AT = 'Y' AND p.USE_AT = 'Y' AND rmp.AUTHORITY_CODE = #{authorityCode} GROUP BY m.MENU_ID, m.MENU_NM, m.MENU_DC, m.PARENT_MENU_ID, m.MENU_ORDR, m.MENU_URL, m.ICON_NM, m.USE_AT ORDER BY m.PARENT_MENU_ID, m.MENU_ORDR, m.MENU_ID

SELECT CASE WHEN MAX(p.PERMISSION_LEVEL) = 'write' THEN 'write' WHEN MAX(p.PERMISSION_LEVEL) = 'read' THEN 'read' ELSE 'none' END as permissionLevel FROM tb_role_menu_permission rmp INNER JOIN tb_menu_info m ON rmp.MENU_ID = m.MENU_ID INNER JOIN tb_permission_type p ON rmp.PERMISSION_ID = p.PERMISSION_ID WHERE rmp.AUTHORITY_CODE = #{authorityCode} AND m.MENU_URL = #{menuUrl} AND rmp.USE_AT = 'Y' AND m.USE_AT = 'Y' AND p.USE_AT = 'Y' ORDER BY m.PARENT_MENU_ID, m.MENU_ORDR, m.MENU_ID
